name: Weapon Experience
author: noire342
description: Ten persistent weapon levels with native localized vN names, acquisition presentations and integrated weapon HUD. Original weapon behavior and visuals by default. Optional damage and ammo-capacity scaling are independently disabled by default. XP follows native enemy bolt payouts and depletion.

settings.name: XP campaign profile
settings.description: Separate XP profile for each campaign. Independent of the game's save slots.

settings.name: Increase damage with weapon level
settings.description: Optional damage scaling, up to 3x at level 10. Restart the game after changing this setting.

settings.name: Increase ammo capacity with weapon level
settings.description: Optional maximum ammo scaling, up to 2.125x at level 10. Does not refill ammo. Restart the game after changing this setting.

settings.name: Show XP inside the original weapon HUD
Maximum XP per kill before multipliers
Show weapon version in native names
Advanced weapon rules filename
settings.description: Editable INI in the XP profile directory. Independent thresholds, damage/ammo curves and XP weights per weapon.

settings.name: Flip Morph-o-Ray upside down
settings.description: Roll the held model upside down around its firing axis. The barrel and native beam still point toward the target.
